Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

translate — to change words into another language. Example: Can you translate it into Spanish?
spell — to say the letters of a word. Example: How do you spell your name?
pronounce — to say a word in the correct way. Example: How do you pronounce this word?
word — a single unit of language. Example: This word is difficult.
meaning — what a word or phrase means. Example: What is the meaning of this word?
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• How do you spell it?
• How do you pronounce this word?
• What does it mean?
• Can you translate it?
• Thank you, I understand.
